scope: Digital PIO and bank research; no analog buffer solver or runtime implementation

open_questions.question: Compose all BASE_TYPE fragments without selecting one of 328 inconsistent fragment defaults. Infer effective direction and buffer paths from joint CRAM constraints, not the original HDL IO_TYPE.
Resolve input/output/tristate paths and PIO/IOLOGIC shared bits under every buffer mode, including bidirectional readback and GSR/GOE/configuration ownership.
Validate true differential A/B drivers versus referenced/differential input A/B and C/D pairs; pseudo-differential top/bottom behavior and package bonding remain separate restrictions.

Define digital resolution of strong/weak drivers, open-drain, pull modes, keeper if supported, undriven inputs and conflicting external drives. Voltage thresholds/hysteresis require explicit environment assumptions.

Bind BCINRD/BCLVDSO for banks 2/3/6/7 to bank wire endpoints and configuration; verify documented active-high power-down polarity, disabled receiver values and wake behavior. Public function is known but bindings remain open.
Decode VCCIO aliases NONE/1V2/1V5 and nextpnr's 1V35-to-1V2 mapping while preserving external bank supply voltage, VREF ownership and incompatible IO settings. CRAM does not measure voltage.
Cover special WRITEN/SPICB0 and other shared configuration pads through startup, user mode and reconfiguration, including package-specific dedicated pins.

Distinguish database-encoded DRIVE/SLEW/CLAMP/termination modes from nextpnr limitations and electrical effects outside the digital emulator; retain configuration without inventing delays or currents.

hardware_cases.stimulus: Exercise input/output/bidir and IOLOGIC selectors with external drive changes and startup GOE; preserve decoded CRAM and both pad and fabric observations.
Compare legal A/B and C/D differential input/output cases with known bank supplies, board connections and package limits; do not drive a rail conflict.
Observe undriven, pulled and open-drain pins using controlled external resistors and known supply/reference values; record digital samples separately from electrical measurements.
Exercise each documented bank controller using externally observable differential/reference inputs and LVDS outputs; verify enable polarity, disabled state and release sequence.
